title: Event Overview – TCS London Marathon 2026
claims: The 2026 TCS London Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 26 April 2026.
The event overview describes the terrain as road, fast and flat.
The event overview lists an elevation gain of 246 feet.
Participants have eight hours to finish the marathon.
The St James's Park Finish Line closes at 23:59:59 on Sunday 26 April.
Participants will be emailed their start wave time approximately three weeks before Marathon Day.
The event provides drinks stations serving BUXTON Natural Mineral Water, Lucozade Sport and Lucozade Sport Energy Gels.
The course has mile and kilometre distance markers.
The event offers free bag drop and toilets, including accessible toilets and female urinals.
If runners fall behind eight-hour pace, the event team may carry out occasional manual bib scans.
